instruction_bn: নির্দেশ অনুযায়ী উপযুক্ত modifier দিয়ে শূন্যস্থান পূরণ করো (Test Paper থেকে সংগৃহীত, 5 marks)।

items.q: ___ students should be attentive to their studies. (pre-modify the noun 'students')
He walked ___ to catch the train. (post-modify the verb 'walked')
The ___ boy stood first. (pre-modify the noun 'boy')
___ rising, the sun spreads light. (use a participle to pre-modify)
The boy narrated the tragic incident ___. (post-modify with an adverbial phrase)
Nazrul, ___, wrote poems of protest. (post-modify with an appositive)
We saw a ___ tiger in the zoo. (pre-modify the noun 'tiger')
He spoke ___ that everybody was moved. (post-modify the verb 'spoke')
